title: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online (NBL Round 8) @ Hungry Jack's App
body:
Deal: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online (NBL Round 8) @ Hungry Jack's App

[new2onlineshopping] For those who prefer to manually enter it in the NBL app, or directly on the NBL website, here , the codeword for tonight's game (Brisbane Bullets v Perth Wildcats) is TRADES.
I will (or other users can) reply to this comment with further codewords as they are announced during this current NBL27 Round 8.
[new2onlineshopping] You're welcome. Enjoy free cheeseburgers for the next five days (Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday). Plus tonight if you want too. 😂😉🤤
[Onemoredeal] Combine with the 6 nuggets and large chips for $4.95, bargain lunch
[Craze] OMG, another already so quickly?? I'll give a couple days pause and claim it before it expires. Thanks OP!
[new2onlineshopping] No pause, weakling. At least two accounts for two cheeseburgers per day . 😉
[fairplay99] Legend! How beautiful the word "Free" looks on the rewards tab 😍
[tunzafun001] Can I use this after midnight so I can use on Friday?
[new2onlineshopping] Yes. After midnight, clicking on the direct link will get you a voucher that expires on Friday.
[yht] If we click now, when it will be expired ?
[Sesew] Loving the free cheeseburgers. Thank you!
[shortgum] OMG. just had so many already! will take a break this week. how many rounds left in NBL ?
